title: MechanicaFluidorum: a verifier-in-the-loop program on 3-D Navier-Stokes global regularity
description: Staged, verifier-in-the-loop research program on 3-D Navier-Stokes global regularity ("Hypothesis U", uniform enstrophy control of the frequency-truncated system). Combines Lean 4 / Mathlib kernel-checked theorems (zero sorry, axiom footprint {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}), exact-rational-arithmetic checkers with demonstrated-failing negative controls, and clearly quarantined floating-point exploration under a strict three-tier epistemic gating system (see SPEC.md, LEDGER.md). Includes docs/paper/exact_triad_structure.pdf, a standalone peer-reviewed paper on the program's proven results: a weighted-triad identity unifying exact energy conservation and enstrophy production, a closed form and exact vanishing locus for Waleffe's helical triad interaction coefficient, and the exact spectrum of the resonant-triad incidence structure on a periodic lattice, with a stated 5/6-gap conjecture on the spherical truncation. Hypothesis U itself remains open; no claim of resolution is made anywhere in this archive.
